Municipality
              of
     Anchorage


     P.O Box 390                  GIRDWOOD VALLEY SERVICE AREA BOARD OF SUPERVISORS
      Girdwood, Alaska 99587                               Jennifer Wingard & Kellie Okonek, Co-Chairs
      http://www.muni.org/gbos                             Brian Burnett, Amanda Tuttle, Nick Crews
    Suzanne LaFrance, Mayor
                         May 18 2026
                     GBOS Regular Meeting
                              Minutes Final
         7:00 p.m. via Microsoft Teams & Girdwood Community Room

This hybrid meeting is taking place via Microsoft Teams & at the Girdwood Community Room, 250 Egloff Rd:

The Girdwood Board of Supervisors is subject to the Alaska Open Meetings Act as found in Alaska Statute 44.62.310
and Anchorage Municipal Code1.25 - Public Meetings.
The Girdwood Board of Supervisors operates under the Girdwood Public Meetings Standards of Conduct.

Call to Order 7:00 p.m. Jennifer Wingard

Land Acknowledgement: The Girdwood Board of Supervisors acknowledges the indigenous peoples of Alaska, whose land we
reside on. The community of Girdwood, situated between the areas known to be Dena'ina and Alutiiq homeland, respects the people
who were stewards of this land for generations. We commit to the continued stewardship of this land and are grateful to be part of a
wider community that seeks to maintain a sustainable use of Girdwood Valley for present and future peoples.

Roll Call:
Attending are Brian Burnett (BB), Amanda Tuttle (AT), Nick Crews (NC), Kellie Okonek (KO), Jennifer Wingard (JW)
No Disclosures

Announcements:
    •  GHEC has two vacant positions, to be filled by registered voters in the Girdwood Valley Service Area. To be
       considered for appointment, email gbos@muni.org.
    •   Girdwood Parks Master Plan project is continuing the approval process. P&Z hearing is scheduled July 6.
        www.girdwoodparksplan.com

Agenda Revisions and Approval:
May 18 2026 GBOS meeting agenda approved             BB/KO        Assent
Amendment to move item #14 to Old Business, consent item  BB/AT         Assent

Minutes Approval:                     April 20 2026 GBOS Meeting minutes approved      BB/NC
                                            April 27 2026 MOA GBOS Meeting minutes approval   BB/NC

Presentations (10 Min):
Resolution of Gratitude: Mike Edgington
Resolution of Gratitude: Briana Sullivan

Consent agenda:    LONO for The Herbal Cache License renewal          Approved



          GBOS Meeting Agendas and minutes are available on line: http://www.muni.org/gbos

                                                                                         1

Reports (5 Min):
1.  Legislative Reports
Sen. Cathy Giessel, Rep. Ky Holland: No report, finishing Legislative Session.
Assembly members – Z. Johnson: 1Q Revisions include funding for Wildland Division
Mayor La France, Bob Dole, Suzanne Fleet-Green, Becky Windt Pearson: Group addresses projects that they have
been focused on including Anchorage Port Construction, Public Safety, Education Funding, resolving vacancies in
Health Dept and MOA Legal Dept.
Anchorage School Board Liaison – Rachel Blakeslee: Legal action due to school closure. ASB is reviewing what could
be restored if school funding increases for the upcoming year.
HLBAC Report – Tim Charnon no report.

2.  Supervisor Reports
Kellie Okonek: Attended GHEC; discussion of Housing Study RFP; No PSAC report
Amanda Tuttle: Attended HLBAC and was pleased to have MOA Watershed Dept there. Unlikely for study this year,
but progress for a study in the future.
Jennifer Wingard: Land Use request for comments on Timberline Drive short plat case by June 12.
Question for MOA staff attending regarding comment at LUC about difference between comps and property tax
assessments. Answer from staff is that the system of valuation for these two purposes is likely different.

3.  Committee updates to GBOS: 3 min each; items not on the agenda but items of interest to the community
None

4.  Standing Reports, see meeting packet
       Proposed Girdwood Developments
       Girdwood Airport Parcel H
      GVSA non-property tax funds
     GBOS Rules and Procedures revisions
      STR Registration and regulation

5.  Service Provider Reports (5 mins each)
Fire – Chief Weston: Chipping planned for June 6, thank you Chugach Electric.
23 calls in April. No news yet on award of Rural Health Grant.
See meeting packet for Wildland Urban Interface Community Action Team information.

Police – Chief Achee
235 calls in Girdwood. Many centered on Spring Carnival weekend.

Roads/Parks & Rec – Kyle Kelley
Summer list includes repairs and maintenance, some of which was caused by extraordinary ice all winter; dust control
and grading. Working with purchasing on contact for roads. Ruane RFP is in Purchasing. Winner Creek Bridge has
approved PO and moving to contract with Spernak. Likely start this fall with completion next year.

Campground opening this weekend, hosts are in. Summer Crew is working hard. Disc golf tournament this weekend.
Pavilion construction at Lions Club Park to start this week.

Group reviews meetings to be scheduled; Budget meetings are priority. Poll to set budget meetings will be sent to
GBOS members soon.
GBOS LUC Joint meeting with DOT re Alyeska Highway speed         Assigned to PSAC Liaison
GBOS Parliamentary Training                                                 Fall
GBOS Special Meeting on Rules and Procedures                            Fall
GBOS meeting to establish chairs and areas of responsibility         Today
GBOS Work Session Re: 2025 Budget/Projects in review              May/early June
GBOS 2027 Budget Work Session Summer 2026 x 2                  June/July/August
Complete for Final Budget Sept GBOS
GBOS Work Session Re: capital projects/leaseback options              later
Anchorage Public Library – Katarina Pavic, Gerrish (Girdwood) Branch Manager

PUBLIC COMMENT:
Mitch Roth: CEA election now, ends May 29.


                                                                                         2

OLD BUSINESS:
6.  Welcome GBOS new members Tuttle and Crews.
   GBOS Roles:

    Motion:
   GBOS moves to approve the assignment of roles outlined as follows:
    Jennifer Wingard: Land Use
    Brian Burnett: Parks and Recreation
     Kellie Okonek: Housing and Economic
   Amanda Tuttle: Police, Roads, Utilities
    Nick Crews: Fire Department
    Motion by KO/2nd AT
    Motion carries 5-0 in roll call vote

    Review of upcoming meetings to be scheduled: Discussed previously.

    Election of Co-chairs for 2026
    Motion:
   GBOS moves to appoint Jennifer Wingard and Kellie Okonek as co-chairs of GBOS for 2026.
    Motion by AT/ 2nd NC
    Motion carries 5-0 in roll call vote

7.  Girdwood Forest Fair 2026 Request for Letter of Non-Objection (LONO) for Permitting and fee waiver
   Some elements of permitting are pending, including insurance. Grand marshal this year are Brooks and Kate Chandler.
   Theme is sparkles, glitter and bubbles.

    Motion:
   GBOS moves to approve the letter of support for 2026 Forest Fair and fee waiver, pending completion of permitting
    Motion by BB/2nd NC
    Motion carries 5-0 in roll call vote

8.  Agenda Item LUC 2605-04: Planning and Zoning case 2026-0062 Amendment to 21.05.040G.2.b to match process for adoption of
    Park Master Plans in Turnagain Arm public or private parks with the process to adopt master plans for Anchorage Parks. P&Z case
    set for public hearing June 8 2026.(Burnett/Staff)
    Girdwood Park Master Plan is the first plan to go through process in many years. Anchorage Parks Plan process has changed over
    the years but Turnagain Arm Process didn’t change over those years. This change will align process of the two.

    Motion:
   GBOS moves to approve the draft Resolution of Support as presented.
    Motion by BB/2nd NC
    Motion carries 4-1 in roll call vote. AT is dissenting vote

9.  Municipal Budget Items: (GBOS GHEC Supervisor/Public Safety Supervisor)
    These items were discussed at MOA GBOS meeting.
     *   Municipal Room Tax funded Tourism Improvement Projects (TIPs) 2027 allocation recommendations from GVSA
      GBOS ideas are Housing Study and RV Park feasibility Study
   GBOS recommendation for funding in 2027 Municipal Budget should be provided in early September to Visit Anchorage, MOA and
      Bill Falsey. AR that set aside the funding is clear in stating that the purpose must “promote tourism”, group is encouraged to review
   AR 2026-55 to make sure proposed projects fit within the definition required.
    Item is to be added to GHEC agenda for review and recommendation.

     *   Municipal levy for police IT projects: potential allocation for WPD IT Girdwood needs. (GBOS Public Safety Supervisor)
    Girdwood-specific projects for consideration of funding.
    Item is to be added to PSAC agenda for review and recommendation.

10. FCC Delegate Clarification (Land Use Committee Supervisor)
    Jennifer Wingard states that FCC as an information source is helpful to Girdwood.
    Girdwood has wrestled with whether to send an official delegate or not. Formal delegate would come from GBOS, and it has been
    previously determined that the member would be the individual who serves as LUC liaison.



                                                                                         3

Motion:
   GBOS moves to participate in the Federation of Community Councils and send the GBOS LUC Liaison to serve as delegate.
    Motion by KO/2nd NC

    Through discussion, motion is amended:

   Amended Motion:
   GBOS moves to send this item to LUC to decide if Girdwood shall participate and send GBOS LUC liaison to serve as delegate,
    status quo will maintain until a different decision is made.
    Motion by KO/2nd NC
    Motion carries by Assent vote

    While this is under discussion at LUC and returns to GBOS, the current situation remains in place, so the GBOS LUC Liaison
    remains the FCC delegate from Girdwood.

    Motion:
   GBOS moves to void the GBOS March 2026 vote regarding FCC delegation. A recused member participated in the discussion for,
    and voted on the matter in which they had a demonstrated conflict of interest, upheld by MOA legal opinion. Additionally GBOS is
     to send a letter to FCC clarifying that they did not have a delegate from Jan 2021-Oct 2025, when the LUC supervisor was elected
     to that role. Mike Edgington was not elected to that role by either LUC or GBOS and therefore was not a legitimate delegate at any
     point.
    Motion by KO/AT

   BB states that this seems outside of the scope of the topic at this time. AT states that item has been discussed in the past but
   GBOS didn’t follow legal opinion at the March meeting regarding conflict of interest. AT moves to call the question, ending
    discussion among GBOS.

    Motion
   GBOS moves to call the question, ending discussion.
    Motion by AT/KO
    Motion carries 4-1 in roll call vote (BB dissenting)

    Vote on original motion. Motion carries 3-2 in roll call vote (BB and NC dissenting)
    Motion carries.

NEW BUSINESS:
11. Girdwood Fire Department request for GBOS Resolution of Support and approval for NTE $20,000 for annual replacement of fire
    hose, turnouts and mattresses from the GVSA Fire Capital account (Chief Weston and GBOS Fire Supervisor)
    Introduced, information is in the meeting packet.
12. Girdwood Fire Department request for GBOS Resolution of Support and approval for NTE $100,000 for command vehicle
    supporting GVSA from the GVSA Fire Capital account. (Chief Weston and GBOS Fire Supervisor)
    Introduced, information is in the meeting packet.
13. Agenda Item LUC 2504-04: GHEC and LUC recommendation for GBOS to provide input and move forward on draft ordinance
    with MOA to allow more flexibility for small forms of housing and relocatable dwelling units in the gR-1, gC-5 and gC-8 zoning
     districts. (Hoke/Chandler, GHEC and/or Land Use Supervisor)
    Although this item is new business for introduction, GBOS discusses that there are safety, fire, density and unintended
    consequences that they want LUC to review more fully before it comes back to GBOS for hearing and vote. Item will return to LUC
     for additional discussion. GBOS seeks information on the requested traffic study for new girdwood townsite (Resolution 2025-14).

REPORTS:
14. Reports (see packet)
    Supervisor reports:
Action Item Updates as assigned:
Request for GBOS/LUC Joint meeting: (0 of 2 required meetings held)
Request for GBOS/GFR Joint meeting (0 of 2 required held)
Request for Executive Session: None
